title: "UseCommand"
---

Processes a Command for use in a component. Always consumes a **stable hook shape** (independent of whether the command is sync/async or debounced), so a command at a given call site can flip between sync↔async or [`Command.DebounceMs`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/input/Command#debouncems) 0↔N across renders without ever reordering hook slots. For a pure sync command with no [`Command.DebounceMs`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/input/Command#debouncems) the original command is returned unchanged (identity preserved). For async commands, wraps ExecuteAsync with automatic IsExecuting tracking and re-entrance guards. When [`Command.DebounceMs`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/input/Command#debouncems) \> 0, wraps the dispatch with a leading-edge debounce: a fire within the window of the prior accepted fire is dropped and [`Command.IsDebouncing`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/input/Command#isdebouncing) (hence [`Command.IsEnabled`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/input/Command#isenabled)=false) reflects the window so the bound control disables, re-enabling when the window elapses. The returned command has a sync Execute action, ExecuteAsync = null, and preserves the authored DebounceMs value (re-passing it through UseCommand is a no-op — debounce is never applied twice).

```csharp
public Command UseCommand(Command command)
public Command<T> UseCommand<T>(Command<T> command)
```

Declared on [`RenderContext`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/components/RenderContext).

**Learn more:** [Commanding](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/commanding), [Hooks](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/hooks)

### `UseCommand<T>(Command<T>)` [#usecommandtcommandt]

Processes a parameterized Command for use in a component. Consumes the same **stable hook shape** as the non-generic [`UseCommand`](#usecommandcommand) and applies the same async tracking and leading-edge [`Command.DebounceMs`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/input/Command-1#debouncems) debounce.

## Use from a class component [#use-from-a-class-component]

Class components can call the same hook directly. These overloads forward to the ones above:

```csharp
protected Command UseCommand(Command command)
protected Command<T> UseCommand<T>(Command<T> command)
```
